productDetail.regionUnpublishedNotice: The supplier has not published a region for this package. It states only which countries are excluded, so we will not guess one.
productDetail.regionAllRegions: The supplier states this package has no regional restriction.
productDetail.regionVerifyHint: Your player ID and server ID decide which package works. If the top-up does not arrive, the region is the first thing to check with us — a top-up sent to the wrong regional package cannot be moved or refunded.
productDetail.regionLockedNotice: This product only works on an account registered in {region}. It cannot be applied to an account from another region, and it cannot be moved or refunded once delivered.
productDetail.regionSiblingsDescription: These are separate regional packages of the same product. They are not interchangeable, so compare the region before you buy.
productDetail.availabilityLive: Confirmed with the supplier a moment ago.
productDetail.availabilityStale: The last supplier check was {age}. The store will re-check before your order is placed.
productDetail.availabilityUnavailable: The supplier currently reports this package as unavailable. Pick another package or contact support.
productDetail.availabilityUnknown: We could not confirm this package with the supplier just now. Ordering can still be tried, and the order is only charged if the supplier accepts it.
productDetail.availabilityStored: Held in our own stock and delivered from here.
productDetail.availabilityPriceChanged: The supplier's cost for this package has moved since our last catalog import. The price you see is the one the catalog states, and the final amount is calculated on the server when you confirm the order.
productDetail.priceConfirmedAtCheckout: The amount is calculated on the server when you confirm — if the price changed since this page loaded, the order is refused rather than charged at the wrong amount.
productDetail.buyingSupplyNone: Nothing extra: this package needs no account details, and the code or account arrives with your order.
productDetail.buyingSupplyFields: We ask for your {fields} at checkout. These are passed to the supplier exactly as typed, so check them character by character — they cannot be edited after the order is confirmed.
productDetail.buyingDeliveryStored: The code is already in our own stock, so it is issued from here as soon as the payment clears.
productDetail.buyingDeliveryDirect: The order goes straight to the supplier and the result is written to your order page, where you can follow its status.
productDetail.buyingDeliveryManual: An operator processes this order against the supplier, so it can take longer than an instant code. Your order page shows the current status.
productDetail.buyingDeliveryAccount: The supplier delivers to the game or platform account you name; nothing is issued to your email.
productDetail.buyingNotePayment: Payment comes from your GH Store wallet balance, and the amount is calculated on the server when you confirm.
productDetail.buyingNoteTerms: Any subscription duration or warranty shown above is the supplier's stated term for this package, not a store guarantee. Where the supplier has not published one, the field stays empty.
productDetail.buyingNoteSupport: Keep your order number for support: it is the only reference we need to look the order up with the supplier.
productDetail.chooseDescription: Each offer is a package for this product. Compare the amount, region and price before continuing.
productDetail.singleOfferDescription: Review this package and its price, then continue to enter any required details.
productDetail.noMatches: No offers match these filters. Try another name or region, or clear the filters.
productDetail.noOffersDescription: Offers for this product are temporarily out of automated stock. You can request it directly from our support team and we will provide it for you.
productDetail.deliveryNote: Review the offer and any required details at checkout. Follow delivery updates from your order page.
productDetail.relatedDescription: Browse these products and compare their available offers.
productDetail.otherOffersDescription: Compare other packages for this same product.
